name: pa-toolkit
description: Pierre-André's personal Claude toolkit (Code + Cowork). decision-gatekeeper: a read-only, domain-agnostic agent that triages a proposed change against a domain's decision records (covered / new / supersede / other note type / operational), driven by the "Profil de gouvernance des décisions" it reads from the Organon vault on every call. Six fin-* skills for PocketSmith categorization, vacation management and Rogers invoices. No bundled .mcp.json — uses the Organon MCP each surface already provides.
